Photos in this folder come from Wikimedia Commons, fetched 2026-11-04 from its /wiki/ file pages and upload.wikimedia.org
(Commons' robots.txt disallows /w/api.php for general agents, so the API was not used). Each was downscaled with sharp
to at most 1600 px on its longer side (the size Lusong sends SAM) and re-encoded as JPEG, which drops its metadata.
Attribution and, for CC BY-SA files, share-alike apply wherever they are shown.
